description: Expected DOM tree that @kadrion/renderer-dom produces for reference.json at the five golden timestamps: mountComposition(root, reference, assetUrls) once, then renderState(root, evaluateComposition(reference, timeUs)). Pure data, derived by hand from reference.expected-state.json and the rule below (D22), never generated from an implementation. `customHtml` lists, per golden timestamp, the one message that synchronizeCustomHtml posts to each Custom HTML element and the one acknowledgement it accepts (D23.3, D23.4), assuming that the host passes the frame index of the golden timestamp as its request ID, as the Producer will. Each `tree` is the one element that the renderer places in `root`: every element with its tag, all of its attributes, all of its inline style declarations, and all of its child nodes, nothing more. PR-48 (D68) moved the colours and the size of the image from the mount to renderState, gave the group the canvas as its box, and added the crop and the corner radius of the image.
rule: Numbers (D22.1): an evaluated number is written as String(n), the ECMAScript Number::toString; a length appends px. Nothing is rounded.

Transform and opacity (D22.2, D68): every transformed node gets transform: translate(<x>px, <y>px) [translate(<ox/10>%, <oy/10>%)] [rotate(<r>deg)] scale(<sx>, <sy>) [translate(-<ox/10>%, -<oy/10>%)] and opacity: <o> from its own state, and transform-origin: 0px 0px. The pivot translations are written only when the origin is not (0, 0), and the rotation only when it is not 0, so every node of the reference composition, at origin (0, 0) without rotation, gets translate(<x>px, <y>px) scale(<sx>, <sy>). No element gets a z-index; DOM order is the array order.

Elements (D22.3, D68): stage div [data-kadrion-composition=""] with position relative, width and height of the canvas, overflow hidden; one scene div [data-kadrion-scene] per scene, absolute at 0px 0px with the canvas size; background div with the scene styles; group div with position absolute, left 0px, top 0px, transform-origin 0px 0px, and the width and height of the canvas, its box (D68); image img [src, alt=""] with position absolute, left 0px, top 0px, transform-origin 0px 0px, display block, object-fit fill, object-position 50% 50% (D63.2: the focus 500, 500 as percentages); text div with the image's first four styles plus white-space pre, font-family kadrion-font-<fontAssetId>, font-size, line-height 1.25, font-weight 400, font-style normal, and one text node; custom-html div with the image's first four styles plus width and height and exactly one child, the iframe of D23.1.

Properties an animation can reach (D68): renderState writes them on every call, before the transform: the background-color of the background and the color of a text from their state; the width and height of an image from its size, its object-view-box inset(<fromTop/10>%, <fromRight/10>%, <fromBottom/10>%, <fromLeft/10>%) from its crop, written with spaces and no commas in the shortest form of CSS (a left equal to the right left out, then a bottom equal to the top, then a right equal to the top), and its border-radius from its corner radius in px. The reference image keeps 400 x 400, no crop, and square corners: width 400px, height 400px, object-view-box inset(0%), border-radius 0px.
Colours: #rrggbb is written as rgb(r, g, b) with decimal channels: #0b1020 is rgb(11, 16, 32), #d0d5dd is rgb(208, 213, 221), #ffffff is rgb(255, 255, 255).
Asset URLs: the host passes `assetUrls` below; src of the image is its entry, and the font URL is required but registers no font face (D22.6).

Static values from reference.json: canvas 1080 x 1920; node-image 400 x 400, asset-image; node-caption 56px, #d0d5dd, "Deterministic by design"; node-title 144px, #ffffff, "Kadrion"; both texts use asset-font; node-custom-html 900 x 40.

Custom HTML element (D23.1, D23.2): iframe with the attributes sandbox="allow-scripts" and srcdoc, in this order, and the styles display block, width and height of the node, and border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, border-left-style none. srcdoc is the shell <!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'"><meta name="kadrion-instance" content="<nodeId>"> followed by the managed clock of D78, one script element whose text begins (function(){"use strict";var INSTANCE="<nodeId>",START=<startUs>,PARAMETERS={},FONTS=[]; for an element with no fonts and no parameters, which needs no style element, then </head> and the html of the node byte for byte. The text of the clock is the program of D78 and is stated by its ADR, not derived here; every tree carries the same one. renderState writes nothing to the iframe.

Messages (D23.3): the host posts {type: "kadrion:time", version: 1, instanceId: <nodeId>, requestId, timeUs} directly to the contentWindow of that iframe and accepts exactly {type: "kadrion:time-ack", version: 1, instanceId, requestId, timeUs} with the same values, and only from that contentWindow. requestId is the frame index of the golden timestamp (0, 75, 150, 225, 297).
